thread:
sophia: FYI nightly eval (run 1718200000) flagged a large QA F1 drop after fp8 profile tweak merged in PR #4321. F1 down ~12% vs baseline on the 'qa-small' promptset. examples attached below.

ajay: ugh. do you have winning/baseline outputs? can repro locally?

sophia: attaching two snippets from failing run:
```
PROMPT: What causes tides on Earth?
BASELINE: Tides are caused primarily by the gravitational pull of the moon and, to a lesser extent, the sun.
NEW (fp8): Tides are caused by the moon and the moon causes the sea to move. the the the the. Also, sometimes the sun is the reason.

PROMPT: Summarize the plot of The Great Gatsby.
BASELINE: The Great Gatsby follows Nick Carraway as he recounts Jay Gatsby's pursuit of Daisy Buchanan and the American Dream, culminating in tragedy.
NEW (fp8): Gatsby is rich and he is in love with Daisy and Gatsby is Gatsby and he wants love and love and love and then someone dies.
```

sophia: note repetition and vagueness — looks like saturation/reduced dynamic range, not classic hallucination pattern.

ajay: running local reproducer now. initial quick-stat shows a handful of per-channel scales hitting max (255). suspicious. may be clamp/saturation in the fp8 kernel.

ajay: hypothesis: compilation's exponent bias mismatch or scale quantization truncation introduced by the new profile. will dump per-layer activation hist and per-channel scales.

dmitri: please run: `./tools/quant_dump --model out/llama4b_fp8 --layers 6-10 --perchannel` and paste the csv. I'll plot.

sophia: done, uploaded csv to the run artifacts (link: https://ci.redwood/test-runs/1718200000/artifacts/scale.csv).

ajay: looking at scale.csv — layer7 channels have long tails and many entries at 255. also saw a handful of NaNs in the folded scale table.

maria: can we rollback the fp8 profile to the previous quant-table while we triage? we should canary rollback to staging first. hosted customers shouldn't see this.

ci-bot: nightly-eval: https://ci.redwood/runs/1718200000 — job: nightly-evals/qa-small — commit: d9f4b2 (PR #4321 merged).

nightly-bot: alert: regression severity HIGH for qa-small F1 drop >10% (auto-tagged).

ajay: quick mitigation: re-run calib with `--folding=false` and `--range-eps=1e-6` to avoid accidental clamps. will run a 50-sample smoke eval.

dmitri: I'll also run int8 baseline eval to check whether similar pattern exists. if int8 is fine then it's fp8-specific.

sophia: also seeing a higher token-repeat rate in log-probs — many tokens near uniform low-entropy. suggests compressed dynamic range at softmax input.

ajay: sharing a tiny repro script I used to dump logits for a sample prompt:
```bash
python -c "from runner import Runner; r=Runner('out/llama4b_fp8'); print(r.logits('What causes tides?')[:10])"
```

maria: if this is reproducible locally we should open an incident and post an internal advisory. please include guidance for rollback and a blocking test in the nightly gate.

ajay: current plan: (1) reproduce deterministically (2) dump per-layer scales/logits (3) try re-calibration with folding off (4) if reproduces, rollback profile on staging and run canary — I'll own steps 1-3. dmitri to run int8 baseline. maria to prep rollback patch. sophia will collect failing prompts/examples for eval owners.

dmitri: int8 baseline run queued (job 1718204300). will report in ~10m.

sophia: tagging @oncall-ml for visibility — possible customer impact if not contained. :warning:

ajay: preliminary smoke (folding=false) shows F1 restored to within 1-2% of baseline on 50-sample test. still running full 1k eval.

maria: great. if smoke holds, coordinate rollback window with infra. keep updates in this thread.

nightly-bot: update: rerun artifacts (smoke) available: https://ci.redwood/runs/1718204000/artifacts/; smoke F1 delta -1.3% vs baseline.

sophia: saving failing examples to the bug: INF-2945 and linking the run.

ajay: next steps: produce a small test (unit/integration) that asserts no per-channel scale hitting max for calibration runs. propose adding to nightly gate.

maria: agree. will create the rollback PR and schedule canary after green smoke.

ci-bot: created PR https://git.redwood/repo/rollback-fp8-profile (branch: rollback/fp8-171820)

sophia: thanks all — will monitor the 1k rerun and update.

ajay: if anyone wants to help repro locally, paste `git clone` and I can share a deterministic seed and tiny dataset.

dmitri: int8 baseline confirms no regression — points to fp8 calibration issue. attaching plots shortly.

sophia: closing loop: keep this thread as the single-source for the triage. will escalate to reliability if rollback is needed for hosted.

maria: noted. :thumbsup:
